subject: ClearWave renewal — pricing bridge & short-term burst request
messages:
From: Sophie Bennett <sophie.bennett@clearwave.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: ClearWave Procurement <procurement@clearwave.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Jun 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ClearWave renewal — pricing bridge & short-term burst request

Hi Aditya,

Hope you’re well. We’re starting our renewal planning for the coming quarter and expect a material spike in inference usage for a pilot we’re launching in July. Our current commit runs out at the end of July and we want to avoid disruptions while we finalize internal approvals for a larger multi-year commit.

Can Redwood do a short-term pricing bridge or burst pool for 60–90 days to cover the pilot? Key asks: a temporary burst allowance (we estimate ~100k extra tokens/month), a short-term price hold on the renewed rate while we finalize the commit size, and a credit mechanism where unused burst is applied to the new commit. I attached our Q2 usage export to give you context.

Timeline: we need a commercial reply this week so procurement can review before the end of June. Happy to jump on a 20–30m call if that helps.

Thanks —
Sophie Bennett
Head of AI Product
ClearWave
Attachment: ClearWave_Q2_usage.xlsx (spreadsheet, 78KB)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Bennett <sophie.bennett@clearwave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2024 10:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearWave renewal — pricing bridge & short-term burst request

Hi Sophie — thanks for the usage file, that helped. High level proposal below (can refine on a call):

- Short-term bridge term: 90 days starting July 1.
- Burst allowance: 100,000 tokens/month above baseline at a discounted bridge rate (20% off the future committed price).
- Price hold: we will hold the proposed renewed committed rate for 90 days from execution date while ClearWave finalizes the multi-year commit.
- Credit mechanics: any unused burst tokens at month-end convert to a dollar credit and are applied against the first invoice of the new committed term. Credits expire after 12 months.
- Ops: we’ll provision a labeled burst pool on our side; usage above burst will bill at standard overage rates.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll put a short commercial amendment (one-pager) together and share a PDF.
2) If that looks OK, procurement can send a PO referencing the amendment and we’ll issue an internal SOW for onboarding the burst pool.
3) Legal will need to sign a 1-paragraph amendment to the SOW; we can parallelize legal review.

Ben/Monica — can you confirm we can create the burst pool with monitoring and a hard stop alert at 1.5x baseline? Also we’ll want finance to confirm the credit accounting flow.

Sophie — I attached a draft summary PDF (RW_proposed_pricing_bridge.pdf). Happy to hop on a quick call today or tomorrow.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachment: RW_proposed_pricing_bridge.pdf (PDF, 42KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Jun 2024 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: internal: ClearWave bridge feasibility

Quick internal note — confirmed with infra that we can create a named burst pool and tag it to the ClearWave account. Ops can set a soft alert at 100k tokens and a hard guard at 150k tokens (1.5x baseline) to avoid runaway spend. Finance flagged that credits converted from unused burst will need to be booked as prepaid credits against the new contract — CFO prefers expiry at 12 months, which matches Aditya's note.

Action items for us:
- Monica: draft the onboarding checklist for provisioning the burst pool and monitoring playbook.
- Aditya: confirm whether sales wants a 20% bridge discount or an alternate structure (e.g., flat monthly burst fee).
- I'll loop Legal for a short amendment template we can re-use.

Ben
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Sophie Bennett <sophie.bennett@clearwave.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: ClearWave Procurement <procurement@clearwave.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2024 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearWave renewal — pricing bridge & short-term burst request

Aditya — this looks reasonable and aligned with procurement's ask. A few small clarifications before we sign:

1) Can the burst allowance be reallocated across teams internally at ClearWave (yes/no)? We might run the pilot across two product teams.
2) Can we lower the hard guard to 1.25x baseline but allow a one-time manual override with written approval from our sponsor?
3) Please confirm credits will appear as a line item on our first committed invoice (not a separate credit memo).

Procurement will prepare a PO after those clarifications; legal will route the amendment through our counsel. If you can confirm the clarifications today, we’ll aim to get PO to you by Thu, June 27.

Thanks —
Sophie Bennett
Head of AI Product
ClearWave
